notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Historians! Here is what we've changed for version 1.0.2 of The Castle Mystery.

[list]
[*] Removed all pumpkins
[*] Added level save system (Automatic saving between levels)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
This update brings The Castle Mystery checkpoints for convenience and a few small patches.

[list]
[*] Fixed small color issue with the start-up screen
[*] Made number-pad input visuals less confusing
[*] Removed a floating screw corresponding to a door in the Dungeon
[*] Removed a small collision issue in the Dungeon
[*] Added checkpoints before all chase scenes
[/list]

Enjoy!
